nonblocking.title: The pilot validation test lets the task's own pytest delete earlier pytest sessions' temporary directories inside a timed command, so it fails depending on what earlier runs left in /tmp
nonblocking.evidence: New. tests/bench/fakes.py:95-117 (SubprocessSandbox.run) runs each task command, here pilot-py-bizdays' 'python3 -m pytest -v' with its 120 s limit, under unshare -rn with the host's /tmp and an environment without TMPDIR. Inside the user namespace the uid is 0, so when the suite runs as root (as in this container) the task's pytest uses /tmp/pytest-of-root, the outer test run's own temp root. pytest 9.1.1 deletes unlocked numbered session directories (all but the newest 3) at session finish, before its terminal summary prints the result line (_pytest/tmpdir.py:315-340, _pytest/terminal.py:957-961, _pytest/pathlib.py:341-371), and a run of this suite leaves about 1.9 GB here (for example /tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-1, 1582 entries). Observed: in my single run of the slow tests on a fresh clone of cec6701 (1 failed, 70 passed, 4 skipped, 474 s), tests/bench/test_validate.py::test_pilot_task_validates[pilot-py-bizdays] failed with 'start_m1m2.tests_fail_as_declared: exit -9 (timed out); no test summary recognized'; its validation took 224 s, against about 8 s and 14 s for the next two pilots. The same test failed in the main session's 1650c79 Python 3.11 prepush. Each failure left an inner bizdays session (/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-172 from my run, created 08:57:34, and pytest-98, created 07:53:03 during the failed prepush) whose 13 test directories were all created within a few milliseconds and whose .lock is still there: the tests ran, and the session never reached its summary. The likely cause, from pytest's code, is that the session was deleting an earlier run's completed session directory when the limit killed it. A full make ship-check runs the suite in G1 and again in G3 (make ci), so on this machine G1 or G3 can fail for this reason alone. GitHub CI starts each job on a fresh runner with no earlier completed run in /tmp and is not affected, the real bubblewrap sandbox gives each command a private /tmp, and no gate passes falsely and no reported number changes. Fix: give the fake sandbox a private TMPDIR under the test's tmp_path.

nonblocking.evidence: New. make report draws docs/figures/demo_report_card.svg (README.md:68, docs/REPORT.md Figure 1) from tests/golden/demo_output.txt (src/receipts/report/spec.py:141-160), including the count '31 more failed hidden checks that the report does not admit'; that output is tools/demo.py run on tests/fixtures/recorded/demo/smoke-ts-parser-tests-ma-qwen7b/ledger.jsonl. None.
